Alex — great questions. High level answers below and I'm looping in Rishi to provide the detailed security artefacts and to kick off the questionnaire formally.

1) SOC 2: Redwood completed a SOC 2 Type II audit for our hosted environment (report Q2 2026). I'm attaching a short SOC2 summary. For full report access we can provide a redacted copy under NDA — Rishi will coordinate.

2) HIPAA/GDPR: We support HIPAA covered workloads under our Private offering and have DPA templates for GDPR. Laura (cc) handles legal/compliance and can share the DPA / BA templates.

3) Telemetry & cookies: Short answer — we collect product usage telemetry from the Console and anonymous analytics on public docs pages. We do not set third-party advertising cookies on the docs site. For private/on-prem deployments telemetry can be turned off entirely and no data leaves the customer's VPC. Rishi will provide the telemetry docs link and a short table of what's collected.

Attachments: SOC2_Summary_Redwood_2026Q2.pdf
Related links: https://redwood.ai/privacy-policy, https://docs.redwood.ai/security/telemetry

I'll let Rishi introduce the questionnaire link and next steps.

Thanks,
Marissa

Subject: Vendor security questionnaire & artefacts (ACME)

Hi Alex / Acme Security Team — Rishi here (Head of Security Ops). Thanks for the questions — we've attached the vendor questionnaire and a pointer to the SOC 2 summary Marissa shared. Please complete the questionnaire at your convenience; we can also take it offline via a call if you prefer.

Quick notes: 
- SOC 2: we can provide the Type II report under NDA.
- Telemetry: product telemetry (Console) captures request/response metrics, timing, and non-PII usage events. Docs site analytics are limited to page views and anonymous events (we use an internal analytics stack; no third-party ad trackers).
- Cookies: we set a minimal session cookie for Console signed sessions and an analytics cookie on docs.redwood.ai. No third-party ad cookies.
- Private/on-prem: telemetry and cookies are configurable and can be disabled.

Vendor questionnaire link: https://app.redwood.ai/surveys/vendor-questionnaire/ACME-001
Attachment: Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx

If you'd like the technical telemetry schema, I can share our telemetry spec as a CSV or short doc. What format do you prefer?

Regards,
